newsitem.title: USA: ATS Medical Q1 net up on implant growth.
newsitem.headline: ATS Medical Q1 net up on implant growth.

text.p: ATS Medical Inc said Monday it posted record earnings and revenues in the first quarter in part because of higher sales of heart valve implants in Europe and Asia.

The company, which makes mechanical heart valves, said net income rose to $577,039, or $0.03 a share, from $192,171, or $0.01 a share, in the same period last year. Sales in the period climbed to $3.4 million from $2.6 million in the first quarter of 1996.
ATS Medical said strong purchases by its Japanese distributor also contributed to this year's gains.
The company said it had implants initiated in all four of its U.S. clinical sites in the first quarter of 1997.
ATS Medical shares closed up 1/2 Monday at 6-3/4.
